text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, good morning!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Look everyone, at that morning sun!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Running and playing every day, dancing at 
night... and then, another new day begins.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —It's the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Moments like this are what I live for. 
And one day, I'm gonna build a giant 
castle—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We'll make this moment last forever. 
Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's train our way toward the 
base camp. Everyone, keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: 2 Fellow Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ooooh…………!

Once we have a base, things will get 
easier. Once we have a base, an eternal 
paradise will come into view.
Tap Dance City doesn't stop. However...

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Referee
text_block_list.text: Goal! And that concludes the mock race!

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Referee
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who placed on the board are 
eligible to race in the afternoon as well. 
Everyone else, please return to basic 
training.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real...? I lost again...

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, there's no way I can 
debut..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Get 'em! Go! Right there! Make your move 
from hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah... darn it! Good grief!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, how pathetic of me... Failing to 
advance once again..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: What have I been doing all this time...?!

While Tap Dance City made smooth progress, 
her friends struggled to show results from 
their summer training.

Reality is harsh for those who cannot 
achieve their goals. For Umamusume, and... 
for humans too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... what is that supposed to 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"‘Maybe I should focus on entrance exams 
after all,’ you said. But you promised, 
didn't you? That we'd always be together."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tap~ I'm sure those kids are having a 
rough time too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I know that! But I want to be with 
everyone! I want to go somewhere I 
belong!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Isn't that true for you guys too!?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That's true, but still~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Is it... about time, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's about time... we woke up. The 
two of us.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you saying!? We can make it! 
Believe me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It might be possible. But the one 
who can make it is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: I'm sure Tap would be the only one.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Not everyone has a heart of steel. 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I really don't wanna be that, y'know~ A 
dead weight... or like, some mooch just 
hanging on.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Making our base all by herself would be 
way too much to put on Tap alone...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! There's no 
keeping score between teammates! Don't 
worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna build it, our very own 
place...! And then...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"From there, we head overseas to conquer a 
GⅠ! I'm gonna take every last one of you 
with me!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's dream a colossal dream no one else 
can even imagine! So come on!

Tap Dance City desperately rallied 
everyone with fiery encouragement. Then, 
one day—

The broadcast of an overseas G1 race was 
playing in the training camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal! Air Shakur courageously took on the 
British G1, and now crosses the finish 
line!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, victory was not meant to 
be. However—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
People from all around the world watched 
that courageous challenge.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What...?! Shakur... made it before me...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (I see... So that's what she...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Is she different from me? From me, who 
crossed the sea all on my own?)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(They've already secured support from 
family... or perhaps a sponsor. Otherwise, 
there's no way they could go overseas.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(The base I've been struggling so 
desperately to attain, she already has 
it...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha!!! What a masterpiece. Our 
fate's been sealed! Hahahaha!!

A dry laugh from Tap Dance City echoed 
through the room at the camp lodge.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you looking so down.
It's rare to see you looking so down.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah, the dream I had was...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is it really such wishful thinking? I 
just... want to laugh together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is even that out of reach... For an 
Umamusume with no pedigree...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Man... Reality really is something else...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Looks like an insanely huge battleship.

Even challenging it with a wooden pirate 
ship, its mighty armor couldn't even be 
scratched...

"The world was 'never fair.' That was an 
undeniable fact."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If this was an impossible challenge from 
the very start—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just quit racing 
altogether. Hahaha...!

A dismissive remark, the likes of which I 
had never heard before, came flying my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I don't really even need to run. 
As long as I can live happily and laugh 
with those guys and you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just throw everything away 
and live by this beach?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure every day would be the best! No 
winning, and no losing either."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Stupid class divides? I'm waving them 
goodbye myself. Hahahaha!

"If only one could step down from the 
race. Umamusume and humans both feel the 
same way."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if we all just slack off here, 
our bodies are gonna get rusty."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, what are we supposed to do 
to live on this beach?

Questioned by Tap Dance City, I let my 
imagination run wild.
If I could live freely by this seaside...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A pirate crew, huh? That's good! Not 
pretend, but a real pirate crew!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Battling swarms of attacking monsters, 
spending every day in thrilling 
swordfights!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I bet everyone's arms are gonna be 
ripped! Ahahaha!"

Imagining a brawny, muscular physique, Tap 
Dance City bursts out laughing from the 
bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: Well... it's just a dream, after all.
Well... it's only a dream, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Treasure hunting, huh? That's good! On a 
vast beach like that, we're bound to find 
something.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If we patiently dig up the beach from one 
end to the other, and happen to strike 
treasure or oil—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"From that point on, every day was a 
festival! Ahahaha!"

"It sounds like it'll take quite a bit of 
patience, but if we find treasure, we'll 
be set to play around every single day!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: Well... it's just a dream, after all.
Well... it's only a dream, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, it's a dream.
choice_data_list:
There's no way a life like that could 
last...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it won't last. I'll probably run out 
of food and die in a ditch.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Still clutching onto the map of a 
treasure island they could never reach.

To keep that from happening, there is only 
one person who can inspire everyone. Yes, 
only the Captain.
choice_data_list:
Tap, can you forgive it? The death of our 
comrade...

Tap, can you forgive it? The death of a 
comrade...

text_block_list.text:
It was a dramatic way to put it. But if 
one were to live life without anything to 
look forward to...

To her, that was truly death. If getting 
off the ship meant being forced into a 
life she never wanted...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Death... Is death waiting for them...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm... still okay.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose my ship and am left 
crawling on the dirt, I have no regrets. 
But...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Them...! I'll never let them go through 
something like that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever on the verge of giving up, 
I'll harden my heart and slap some sense 
into your rear!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Don't throw it away! Like 
hell I'd let you guys end up miserable! 
...Or something like that.

"We made eye contact and laughed. We both 
knew what we had to do."
choice_data_list: Let's go check on your buddy's training.
Let's go check on your friend's training.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Those guys are just getting way too 
down on themselves anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you get hit, you hit back. I'll teach 
you that, Trainer!

She let out a bright laugh. Tap Dance City 
wasn't just bringing joy to herself, but—

"Supporting even those friends on the 
verge of falling behind, they dashed 
through the summer."
